ddl.value: "status" <> 'pending' OR ("accepted_at" IS NULL AND "connected_at" IS NULL AND "closed_at" IS NULL)
ddl.name: introductions_pending_data_check

ddl.value: "status" <> 'accepted' OR ("accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "connected_at" IS NULL AND "closed_at" IS NULL)
ddl.name: introductions_accepted_data_check

ddl.value: "status" NOT IN ('declined', 'withdrawn') OR ("closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "accepted_at" IS NULL AND "connected_at" IS NULL)
ddl.name: introductions_closed_data_check

ddl.value: "status" <> 'connected' OR ("accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "connected_at" IS NOT NULL AND "closed_at" IS NULL)
ddl.name: introductions_connected_data_check
